title: Transient conjugate heat transfer in internally heated ceramic pebble beds: pore-resolved reference fields and graph–Transformer prediction
description: Open-source programs, registered inputs, compact processed data and reproducibility records for pore-resolved conjugate heat transfer and reduced-order temperature prediction in internally heated ceramic pebble beds.
